attributes.action: Ban the use of all weedkillers that aren’t pet friendly. #JusticeForJett
attributes.additional_details:
This petition is in loving memory of our beautiful cat Jett, and a 2nd much‑loved family cat, killed by poisoning from toxic weedkiller applied by SLC, near our home on 4/6/26.
What makes this worse and why these new laws are needed, is the conduct of workers. Staff saw Jett lying there, instead of seeking help, or moving his body respectfully, they cut the grass and left a patch of grass uncut around him, proving they knew he was there and chose to ignore him, leaving him for my child to find.
attributes.background: We call on the Scottish Parliament to ban all weedkillers unsafe for pets/wildlife. Councils must use only pet‑friendly methods. Clear 48 hour advance warnings and a legal duty to remove dead/injured animals will prevent suffering like ours: two family cats killed by council poisons. #JusticeForJett
